mentions.name: Text Connection System
mentions.description: This system connects texts such as books and research papers in meaningful ways, helping people decide what to read and become aware of how texts relate to each other. The author plans to make it open-source later.
mentions.problem: People struggle to decide what to read and to be aware of how texts relate to each other.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a system that connects texts (books, research papers, etc.) in a meaningful way to help people decide what to read and be aware of how texts relate to each other.
mentions.author: nwhnwh
